Resolve the operating context first:\n37\t   - If the user provides a repository, PR number, issue number, or URL, use that.\n38\t   - If the request is about \"this branch\" or \"the current PR\", resolve local git context and use `gh` only as needed to discover the branch PR.\n39\t   - If the repository is still ambiguous after local inspection, ask for the repo identifier.\n40\t2. Classify the request before taking action:\n41\t   - `repo or PR triage`: summarize PRs, issues, patches, comments, labels, reactions, or repository state\n42\t   - `review follow-up`: unresolved review threads, requested changes, or inline review feedback\n43\t   - `CI debugging`: failing checks, Actions logs, or CI root-cause analysis\n44\t   - `publish changes`: create or switch branches, stage changes, commit, push, and open a draft PR\n45\t3. Route to the specialist skill as soon as the category is clear:\n46\t   - Review comments and requested changes: `../gh-address-comments/SKILL.md`\n47\t   - Failing GitHub Actions checks: `../gh-fix-ci/SKILL.md`\n48\t   - Commit, push, and open PR: `../yeet/SKILL.md`\n49\t4. Keep the hybrid model consistent after routing:\n50\t   - connector first for PR and issue data\n51\t   - local `git` and `gh` only for the specific gaps the connector does not cover\n52\t\n53\t## Default Workflow\n54\t\n55\t1. Resolve repository and item scope.\n56\t2. Gather structured PR or issue context through the GitHub app from this plugin.\n57\t3. Decide whether the task stays in connector-backed triage or needs a specialist skill.\n58\t4. Route immediately when the work becomes review follow-up, CI debugging, or publish workflow.\n59\t5. End with a clear summary of what was inspected, what changed, and what remains.\n60\t\n61\t## Output Expectations\n62\t\n63\t- For triage requests, return a concise summary of the repository, PR, or issue state and the next likely action.\n64\t- For mixed requests, tell the user which specialist path you are taking and why.\n65\t- For connector-backed write actions, restate the exact PR, issue, label, or reaction target before applying the change.\n66\t- Never imply that GitHub Actions logs are available through the connector alone. Repository files navigation\nL177: \nL178:   *   * cite99†README L179:   * cite99†MIT license L180: \nL181: More items\nL182: ## Introduction\nL183: \nL184: MSST-GUI is a Qt5-based inference GUI, designed to provide a convenient and intuitive way to inference (mainly for my own use). At its core, it's a GUI that uses a specified Python environment to add parameters and call `inference.py`. As such, you can also package `msst_gui_en.py` as a cite100†smaller executable file and use it in the main repository.\nL185: Inferences are executed sequentially on the target audio from top to bottom. For example, enabling Vocal Model, Karaoke Model, and Reverb Model for a song will directly yield the dry main vocal. Hover your mouse over the corresponding areas to see explanatory information.\nL186: \nL187: MSST-GUI also comes equipped with a configuration editor, allowing you to add and use your own models or edit existing ones. ConfigDict\\nfrom torch.optim import Adam, AdamW, SGD, RAdam, RMSprop\\nfrom tqdm.auto import tqdm\\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Any, Union, Optional\\nimport loralib as lora\\nfrom .muon import SingleDeviceMuonWithAuxAdam\\nimport torch.distributed as dist\\n\\ndef demix(\\n    config: ConfigDict,\\n    model: torch.nn.Module,\\n    mix: torch.Tensor,\\n    device: torch.device,\\n    model_type: str,\\n    pbar: bool = False\\n) -> Union[Dict[str, np.ndarray], np.ndarray]:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Perform audio source separation with a given model.\\n\\n    Supports both Demucs-specific and generic processing modes, including\\n    overlapping chunk-based inference with optional progress bar display.\\n    Handles padding, fading, and batching to reduce artifacts during separation.\\n\\n    Args:\\n        config (ConfigDict): Configuration object with audio and inference\\n            parameters (chunk size, overlap, batch size, etc.).\\n        model (torch.nn.Module): Source separation model for inference.\\n        mix (torch.Tensor): Input audio tensor of shape (channels, time).\\n        device (torch.device): Device on which to run inference (CPU or CUDA).\\n        model_type (str): Type of model (e.g., 'htdemucs', 'mdx23c') that\\n            determines processing mode.\\n        pbar (bool, optional): If True, show a progress bar during chunk\\n            processing. Defaults to False.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        Union[Dict[str, np.ndarray], np.ndarray]:\\n            - Dictionary mapping instrument names to separated waveforms if\\n              multiple instruments are predicted.\\n            - NumPy array of separated audio if only a single instrument is\\n              present (Demucs mode).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    should_print = not dist.is_initialized() or dist.get_rank() == 0\\n\\n    mix = torch.tensor(mix, dtype=torch.float32)\\n\\n    if model_type == 'htdemucs':\\n        mode = 'demucs'\\n    else:\\n        mode = 'generic'\\n    # Define processing parameters based on the mode\\n    if mode == 'demucs':\\n        chunk_size = config.training.samplerate * config.training.segment\\n        num_instruments = len(config.training.instruments)\\n        num_overlap = config.inference.num_overlap\\n        step = chunk_size // num_overlap\\n    else:\\n        if 'chunk_size' in config.inference:\\n            chunk_size = config.inference.chunk_size\\n        else:\\n            chunk_size = config.audio.chunk_size\\n        num_instruments = len(prefer_target_instrument(config))\\n        num_overlap = config.inference.num_overlap\\n\\n        fade_size = chunk_size // 10\\n        step = chunk_size // num_overlap\\n        border = chunk_size - step\\n        length_init = mix.shape[-1]\\n        windowing_array = _getWindowingArray(chunk_size, fade_size)\\n        # Add padding for generic mode to handle edge artifacts\\n        if length_init > 2 * border and border > 0:\\n            mix = nn.functional.pad(mix, (border, border), mode=\\\"reflect\\\")\\n\\n    batch_size = config.inference.batch_size\\n\\n    use_amp = getattr(config.training, 'use_amp', True)\\n\\n    with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=use_amp):\\n        with torch.inference_mode():\\n            # Initialize result and counter tensors\\n            req_shape = (num_instruments,) + mix.shape\\n            result = torch.zeros(req_shape, dtype=torch.float32)\\n            counter = torch.zeros(req_shape, dtype=torch.float32)\\n\\n            i = 0\\n            batch_data = []\\n            batch_locations = []\\n            if pbar and should_print:\\n                progress_bar = tqdm(\\n                    total=mix.shape[1], desc=\\\"Processing audio chunks\\\", leave=False\\n                )\\n            else:\\n                progress_bar = None\\n\\n            while i < mix.shape[1]:\\n                # Extract chunk and apply padding if necessary\\n                part = mix[:, i:i + chunk_size].to(device)\\n                chunk_len = part.shape[-1]\\n                if mode == \\\"generic\\\" and chunk_len > chunk_size // 2:\\n                    pad_mode = \\\"reflect\\\"\\n                else:\\n                    pad_mode = \\\"constant\\\"\\n                part = nn.functional.pad(part, (0, chunk_size - chunk_len), mode=pad_mode, value=0)\\n\\n                batch_data.append(part)\\n                batch_locations.append((i, chunk_len))\\n                i += step\\n\\n                # Process batch if it's full or the end is reached\\n                if len(batch_data) >= batch_size or i >= mix.shape[1]:\\n                    arr = torch.stack(batch_data, dim=0)\\n                    x = model(arr)\\n\\n                    if mode == \\\"generic\\\":\\n                        window = windowing_array.clone() # using clone() fixes the clicks at chunk edges when using batch_size=1\\n                        if i - step == 0:  # First audio chunk, no fadein\\n                            window[:fade_size] = 1\\n                        elif i >= mix.shape[1]:  # Last audio chunk, no fadeout\\n                            window[-fade_size:] = 1\\n\\n                    for j, (start, seg_len) in enumerate(batch_locations):\\n                        if mode == \\\"generic\\\":\\n                            result[..., start:start + seg_len] += x[j, ..., :seg_len].cpu() * window[..., :seg_len]\\n                            counter[..., start:start + seg_len] += window[..., :seg_len]\\n                        else:\\n                            result[..., start:start + seg_len] += x[j, ..., :seg_len].cpu()\\n                            counter[..., start:start + seg_len] += 1.0\\n\\n                    batch_data.clear()\\n                    batch_locations.clear()\\n\\n                if progress_bar:\\n                    progress_bar.update(step)\\n\\n            if progress_bar:\\n                progress_bar.close()\\n\\n            # Compute final estimated sources\\n            estimated_sources = result / counter\\n            estimated_sources = estimated_sources.cpu().numpy()\\n            np.nan_to_num(estimated_sources, copy=False, nan=0.0)\\n\\n            # Remove padding for generic mode\\n            if mode == \\\"generic\\\":\\n                if length_init > 2 * border and border > 0:\\n                    estimated_sources = estimated_sources[..., border:-border]\\n\\n    # Return the result as a dictionary or a single array\\n    if mode == \\\"demucs\\\":\\n        instruments = config.training.instruments\\n    else:\\n        instruments = prefer_target_instrument(config)\\n\\n    ret_data = {k: v for k, v in zip(instruments, estimated_sources)}\\n\\n    if mode == \\\"demucs\\\" and num_instruments <= 1:\\n        return estimated_sources\\n    else:\\n        return ret_data\\n\\n\\ndef initialize_model_and_device(model: torch.nn.Module, device_ids: List[int]) -> Tuple[Union[torch.device, str], torch.nn.Module]:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Move a model to the correct computation device and wrap with DataParallel if needed.\\n\\n    Selects GPU(s) if CUDA is available; otherwise defaults to CPU. If multiple\\n    GPU IDs are provided, wraps the model with `nn.DataParallel` for multi-GPU\\n    execution.\\n\\n    Args:\\n        model (torch.nn.Module): PyTorch model to be initialized.\\n        device_ids (List[int]): List of GPU device IDs to use. If length > 1,\\n            the model will be wrapped with DataParallel.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        Tuple[Union[torch.device, str], torch.nn.Module]: A tuple containing:\\n            - The computation device (`torch.device` or \\\"cpu\\\").\\n            - The model moved to that device (wrapped in DataParallel if applicable).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    if torch.cuda.is_available():\\n        if len(device_ids) <= 1:\\n            device = torch.device(f'cuda:{device_ids[0]}')\\n            model = model.to(device)\\n        else:\\n            device = torch.device(f'cuda:{device_ids[0]}')\\n            model = nn.DataParallel(model, device_ids=device_ids).to(device)\\n    else:\\n        device = 'cpu'\\n        model = model.to(device)\\n        print(\\\"CUDA is not available.     "text": "9\tdef clean_weights(args):"

  {

  {

    "text": "15\t        for el in weights:"
  },
  {

    "text": "16\t            weights[el] = weights[el].to(torch.float16)"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",

  },
  {

  },
  {

  },
  {

    "text": "23\t    parser.add_argument('--checkpoint', type=str, help=\"Input checkpoint to clean\")"
  },
  {

  {

    "text": "34\t        args = parser.parse_args()"
  },

  },

  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "1\timport os"

    "type": "input_text",

  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "3\timport argparse"

  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "4\tfrom typing import List, Optional, Union, Dict"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "7\tdef parse_args(dict_args: Union[Dict, None]) -> argparse.Namespace:"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "8\t    \"\"\""
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "9\t    Parse command-line arguments for configuring the model, dataset, and training parameters."
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "11\t    Args:"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",

  {
    "type": "input_text",

  {

  {

    "text": "16\t    \"\"\""
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "18\t    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"Copy mixture files from VALID_PATH to INFERENCE_DIR\")"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "19\t    parser.add_argument('--valid_path', type=str, help=\"Directory with valid tracks\")"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "20\t    parser.add_argument('--inference_dir', type=str, help=\"Directory to save inference tracks\")"
  },
  {

    "text": "21\t    parser.add_argument('--mixture_name', type=str, default='mixture.wav', help=\"Name of mixture tracks (default: 'mixture.wav')\")"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "22\t    parser.add_argument('--max_mixtures', type=int, default=float('inf'), help=\"Maximum number of mixtures to process.\")"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "24\t    if dict_args is not None:"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "25\t        args = parser.parse_args([])"
  },
  {

  },

  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "35\tdef copying_files(args: Optional[argparse.Namespace] = None) -> None:"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "36\t    \"\"\""
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "37\t    Main function to copy mixture files from valid directory to inference directory."
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "39\t    Parameters:"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "40\t    ----------"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "41\t    args : Optional[argparse.Namespace]"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "42\t        The parsed arguments containing valid_path, inference_dir, and mixture_name."
  },
  {

    "text": "43\t    \"\"\""
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "44\t    args = parse_args(args)"

  {

  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "47\t    inference_dir = args.inference_dir"
  },
  {
    "type": "input_text",
    "text": "48\t    mixture_name = args.mixture_name"
  },
  {

### 45. 助手消息（2026-08-15T03:06:18.171Z）

~~~~
结论：这个项目能在你这台电脑上运行，但它不是“一键安装”，而且它主要是“音乐源分离推理 GUI”，不是训练 GUI。它的特点是可以把多个模型串联起来：人声分离 → 和声分离 → 去混响 → 降噪。项目说明和代码都确认了这一点。[README](https://github.com/AliceNavigator/Music-Source-Separation-Training-GUI#readme)

你电脑当前条件：

- RTX 4060 Laptop，8GB 显存；当前约有 6GB 可用，适合先跑快速模式和单个模型。
- D 盘约有 52GB 可用空间。
- 已经有 D 盘上的 UVR、GPT-SoVITS、RVC 环境。
- MSST-GUI 当前尚未安装；系统没有普通的全局 Python，不能直接在现有环境里盲目安装。

推荐安装结构：

```text
D:\MSST-GUI\
├─ msst_gui_zh.exe
├─ inference.py
├─ configs\
├─ models\
├─ pretrain\
│  └─ 人声模型.ckpt
├─ env\
│  └─ Scripts\python.exe
├─ input\
└─ separation_results\
```

实际使用需要四部分：

1. 从仓库下载代码，并把最新中文 GUI 放进根目录。当前可见最新版本是 [v1.4.0](https://github.com/AliceNavigator/Music-Source-Separation-Training-GUI/releases/tag/v1.4.0)。
2. 在 D 盘建立独立 Python 环境。不要修改现有 GPT-SoVITS 或 RVC 环境。
3. 下载至少一个预训练模型放进 `pretrain`。仓库里的 `pretrain` 目录本身没有模型，只有占位文件；模型和配置需要从[预训练模型列表](https://github.com/AliceNavigator/Music-Source-Separation-Training-GUI/blob/main/docs/pretrained_models.md)单独下载。
4. 启动 GUI 后：
   - 推理环境设置为 `D:\MSST-GUI\env\Scripts\python.exe`
   - 输入音频放进 `input`
   - 第一次只选一个人声模型
   - 勾选“快速推理模式”
   - 关闭 TTA
   - 运行后检查 `separation_results`

代码实际会依次调用 `inference.py`，并把每个模块的结果放到 `separation_results`、`karaoke_results`、`deverb_results` 等目录。[GUI 推理链路](https://github.com/AliceNavigator/Music-Source-Separation-Training-GUI/blob/main/msst_gui_zh.py#L1782-L1850)

我的判断是：

- 只想提取人声/伴奏：你现有的 UVR 已经可以直接完成，不必重复安装。
- 想做“人声提取后继续去和声、去混响、降噪”的级联处理：这个项目有价值。
- 你的 8GB 显存不建议一开始同时启用四个模块；先用短音频、单模型、快速配置测试。
- “归档结果”按钮会移动并清空输入/结果文件，第一次使用时不要急着点击。[archive.py](https://github.com/AliceNavigator/Music-Source-Separation-Training-GUI/blob/main/archive.py)

我目前只完成了项目和本机环境检查，没有下载、安装或修改任何东西。若你希望我现在直接落地，我下一步可以在 `D:\MSST-GUI` 建立独立环境，下载项目和一个模型，并先跑一个短音频验证；现有 UVR、GPT-SoVITS、RVC 环境会保留不动。

Resolve the operating context first:\n37\t   - If the user provides a repository, PR number, issue number, or URL, use that.\n38\t   - If the request is about \"this branch\" or \"the current PR\", resolve local git context and use `gh` only as needed to discover the branch PR.\n39\t   - If the repository is still ambiguous after local inspection, ask for the repo identifier.\n40\t2. Classify the request before taking action:\n41\t   - `repo or PR triage`: summarize PRs, issues, patches, comments, labels, reactions, or repository state\n42\t   - `review follow-up`: unresolved review threads, requested changes, or inline review feedback\n43\t   - `CI debugging`: failing checks, Actions logs, or CI root-cause analysis\n44\t   - `publish changes`: create or switch branches, stage changes, commit, push, and open a draft PR\n45\t3. Route to the specialist skill as soon as the category is clear:\n46\t   - Review comments and requested changes: `../gh-address-comments/SKILL.md`\n47\t   - Failing GitHub Actions checks: `../gh-fix-ci/SKILL.md`\n48\t   - Commit, push, and open PR: `../yeet/SKILL.md`\n49\t4. - `MISSING_DEPENDENCY`：列出缺少的 Demucs、PyTorch、FFmpeg 或 ffprobe；不得自动安装。\n18\t   - `CPU_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`：仅当 PyTorch 已安装且明确检测不到 CUDA 时，说明 CPU 处理可能很慢；用户同意后显式传入 `--device cpu`。`unknown_missing_torch` 应先解决依赖，不得推断只能使用 CPU。\n19\t   - `OUTPUT_EXISTS`：让用户选择 `skip`、`overwrite` 或 `version`；不得默认覆盖。\n20\t   - `OUTPUT_COLLISION`：多个输入解析到同一结果目录；调整输入名或输出根目录，不得继续运行。\n21\t   - `model_download_required`：已确认模型包所需权重未全部缓存，首次真实运行前说明 Demucs 将下载权重并征求同意。\n22\t   - `model_download_may_be_required`：仅在无法确认缓存状态时使用；首次真实运行前说明 Demucs 可能下载权重并征求同意。\n23\t   - 输入或输出位于当前可写工作区外：通过正常权限流程取得授权，不绕过沙箱。\n24\t4. 默认使用 `--model htdemucs_ft` 和二轨 24 位 WAV 输出。不要自动改为四轨、MP3、降噪、去混响或响度增强。\n25\t5. 真实运行后读取汇总 JSON，并核对解析后的结果目录中确实存在非空的 `vocals.wav`、`instrumental.wav` 和 `manifest.json`。\n26\t6. 向用户提供三个结果文件的绝对路径。请用户试听人声；若主模型串音或伪影明显，再征求同意用 `--model mdx_extra` 生成独立对比目录。\n27\t7. 如果用户要求增强，先分析具体问题，再制定独立处理方案；不得直接套固定滤镜。\n28\t\n29\t## 调用方式\n30\t\n31\t从本 Skill 目录解析脚本绝对路径，并使用通过预检的 Python 解释器：\n32\t\n33\t```text\n34\tpython scripts/extract_vocals.py INPUT [INPUT ...]\n35\t    [--output-root PATH]\n36\t    [--temp-root PATH]\n37\t    [--cache-root PATH]\n38\t    [--recursive]\n39\t    [--model htdemucs_ft|mdx_extra]\n40\t    [--device auto|cuda|cpu]\n41\t    [--existing error|skip|overwrite|version]\n42\t    [--dry-run]\n43\t```\n44\t\n45\t默认先执行：\n46\t\n47\t```text\n48\tpython scripts/extract_vocals.py \"歌曲路径\" --dry-run\n49\t```\n50\t\n51\t预检确认后，再使用显式设备和已有结果策略执行。项目需要集中管理产物时传入 `--output-root`；运行中间文件传入 `--temp-root`，持久化的 Torch/Demucs/pip 缓存传入 `--cache-root`。`--temp-root` 下的每首歌曲临时目录在成功或失败后自动清理；`--cache-root` 保留已下载权重供下次复用。省略输出根目录时保持歌曲旁输出，省略缓存参数时保持原有默认行为。不要省略路径引号。\n52\t\n53\t## 环境策略\n54\t\n55\t- 优先复用已验证可用的现有 Python 3.10+ 环境。\n56\t- 现有环境不兼容时，说明计划安装的版本、目录和磁盘影响；得到同意后才在本 Skill 的 `.venv` 中创建项目专用环境。\n57\t- 安装 PyTorch 时按实际 CPU/CUDA 环境选择兼容构建，不猜测 CUDA 版本。\n58\t- 不自动安装 FFmpeg，不自动访问云端，不上传音频。预检会实际运行 `ffmpeg -version` 和 `ffprobe -version`，仅存在但不可执行的链接不算可用。\n59\t- 系统 PATH 不可用但已有可运行程序时，可分别设置 `FFMPEG_PATH` 和 `FFPROBE_PATH` 指向绝对路径；预检 JSON 会报告最终采用的路径。\n60\t- `--temp-root` 和 `--cache-root` 只为当前 Skill 进程及其 Demucs 子进程设置 `TEMP`、`TMP`、`TORCH_HOME`、`XDG_CACHE_HOME` 和 `PIP_CACHE_DIR`，不修改 Windows 系统环境变量。\n61\t\n62\t## 成功标准\n63\t\n64\t- 原文件的 SHA-256、大小和修改时间保持不变。\n65\t- 两个结果均为可解码的 24 位 PCM WAV，时长差不超过 0.1 秒，采样率、声道和位深一致。\n66\t- 近似静音或峰值达到满刻度只作为警告报告；不要把主观分离质量伪装成自动检测结论。\n67\t- `manifest.json` 的 `validation_status` 为 `passed`，并记录模型、设备、工具版本、耗时和音频指标。\n68\t\n69\t## 禁止事项\n70\t\n71\t- 不覆盖、删除、移动或重编码原歌曲。\n72\t- 不把“已生成文件”描述为“完全纯净人声”；混响、和声和乐器串音需要试听判断。\n73\t- 不在用户未批准时安装依赖、下载模型、使用 CPU 长时间运行或覆盖旧结果。\n74\t\n\n(Complete: 4 files processed.)"}]

Deploy only saved versions; every Sites deployment URL is production. Inspect deployment status when the initial result is non-terminal or the user asks for progress. If it is missing, keep the persisted project_id and call create_source_repository_write_credential; do not call create_site again. The credential can be reused for pushes until it expires. Use per-command Git authentication; never expose or persist its token. ### 310. 助手消息（2026-08-15T03:54:51.070Z）

~~~~
已定位到当前实际根因，不是模型路径或 CUDA：

`inference.py`` 在加载 639 MB 模型时，Windows 报 `DefaultCPUAllocator: not enough memory`，连 786 KB 的内存申请都失败，进程退出码为 1。也就是说机器当前可用内存不足；我现在检查是哪几个进程占满内存，并只处理 MSST 自己的残留，不会动你现有的 RVC/GPT-SoVITS/UVR 进程。
~~~~
